title: Account Executive – Field Sales
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Dev Rev</strong></span></p> <p>At Dev Rev, we're building the future of work with <em>Computer</em> – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, <em>Computer</em> unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, Dev Rev is trusted by global companies across industries.</p></div><p><strong>Job Description</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an untraditional Saa S revenue organization, built to support a rapidly scaling technology start-up driven by product-led-growth and sales (PLG / PLS). </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">Specific responsibilities for account executives include nurturing larger named accounts &amp; enterprise customers
- who are looking for a better way to connect with their customers and find product market fit. You will work closely with customers end-to-end throughout their lifecycle
- from concept to technical requirements, implementation, adoption, expansion, and paid. This is truly an expansive sales responsibility that spans selling, success, and support. Activities related to this role will, for example, include:</span></p> <ul> <li>Build outreach to existing rolodex and new opportunities.</li> <li>Relentless manage customer followup and your own pipeline, against quotas.</li> <li>Work with our Growth team to increase product awareness.</li> <li>Nurture and follow up with customers to share relevant use cases, find key decision makers, and gather requirements.</li> <li>Guide customers through implementation plans to further adoption and drive paid conversion.</li> <li>Work with our Product and Engineering to share feedback and feature requests.</li> <li>Create content and refine scripts to support the customer journey and engagement points.</li> <li>Maintain pipeline data and account information in Dev Rev's in-house CRM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ideal Candidate

QUALIFICATIONS:
<br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>New Business Development Skills:</strong>&nbsp;Demonstrated ability to identify and pursue new business opportunities, including prospecting, cold calling, and networking to generate leads and expand the customer base.</li> <li><strong>Entrepreneurial Spirit:</strong>&nbsp;A proactive and innovative approach to sales, with a mindset focused on growth, creativity, and taking ownership of outcomes. This includes a willingness to experiment with new strategies and approaches to achieve sales targets.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Thinker:</strong>&nbsp;Capable of developing and executing strategic sales plans that align with company objectives and market trends. This involves analyzing market data, identifying growth opportunities, and adapting tactics accordingly.</li> <li><strong>Autonomous and Self-Motivated:</strong>&nbsp;Comfortable working independently and taking initiative to drive sales initiatives forward. This includes being self-motivated to meet and exceed sales targets without constant supervision.</li> <li><strong>Passion and Commitment:&nbsp;</strong>Demonstrates a strong passion for the product and industry, coupled with a commitment to delivering exceptional customer service and building long-term relationships.</li> <li><strong>Risk-Taker and Resilient:</strong>&nbsp;Willingness to embrace risk and overcome setbacks with resilience. Ideal candidate embodies founder's mentality, often entails a high tolerance for ambiguity and the ability to navigate uncertainty.</li> <li><strong>Customer-Centric Approach:</strong>&nbsp;Prioritizes understanding customer needs and providing tailored solutions that add value and drive customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Problem Solver:</strong>&nbsp;Ability to think creatively to address customer challenges and differentiate the company's offerings in a competitive market.</li> <li><strong>Leadership Potential:</strong>&nbsp;Exhibits leadership qualities such as vision, influence, and the ability to inspire and motivate others toward shared goals.</li> </ul> <p>The ideal candidate drives immediate sales but also contributes to the overall growth and success of the business through their entrepreneurial mindset and strategic thinking.</p> <p>As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Dev Rev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.</em></p></div>

jobDescription: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About Dev Rev</strong></span></p> <p>At Dev Rev, we're building the future of work with <em>Computer</em> – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, <em>Computer</em> unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, Dev Rev is trusted by global companies across industries.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <div> <p>We're looking for a versatile designer with exceptional craft who can jump into any creative challenge and elevate it. Brand campaign one week, event toolkit the next, presentation system the week after – you're comfortable with all of it and brilliant at most of it.</p> <p>This isn't a production role. You'll own art direction on projects, shape visual language for campaigns, and set a quality standard that pulls the team upward. You'll work with minimal oversight and your judgment will be trusted.</p> <p>You'll join a team of designers in Bengaluru and work closely with creative leadership in London. The role is based in our Bengaluru office.</p> </div> <div> <p>&nbsp;</p> </div> <div><strong>What you'll do</strong> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Produce outstanding brand and campaign work</strong><strong><br></strong>Designing across the full range of creative studio output, your work is consistently excellent regardless of the medium or deadline.</li> <li><strong>Own art direction on projects</strong><strong><br></strong>You won't wait for someone to tell you how it should look. You'll develop the visual approach, present it with conviction, and push it to a level that surprises people. Your creative judgment is the reason projects succeed.</li> <li><strong>Raise the quality bar</strong><strong><br></strong>Your craft is visible. You influence the designers around you, not by managing them, but by producing work they want to match.</li> <li><strong>Work across every touchpoint</strong><strong><br></strong>Brand campaigns. Web pages. Sales decks. Event signage. Social content. Presentation templates. You bring the same quality to everything and enjoy the variety.</li> </ul> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><strong>What you'll bring</strong> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Experience &amp; portfolio</strong><strong><br></strong>5-7 years of professional design experience with a portfolio that demonstrates range and craft across brand, digital, and print. We want to see strong fundamentals – typography, layout, colour, composition – applied to a variety of outputs.</li> <li><strong>Craft excellence</strong><strong><br></strong>Deep typographic sensibility. Strong compositional instinct. An eye for detail that extends to final production.
